column3: Being left out hurts. And researchers have looked at why.
People in a brain scanner played a simple game of catch. Then the other players stopped throwing them the ball.
The more left out they felt, the more a brain region also involved in physical pain lit up.
It was a small study, so think overlap, not identical. But it fits Naruto's childhood perfectly.
Loneliness is a signal, like hunger. It means something you need is missing.
